entry_points.name: delete_account
entry_points.note: Takes a session and a user_id and deletes the matching users row.

stores.name: users

erasure.note: The route loads the User row and calls session.delete on it, then commits.

stores.note: The single SQLAlchemy table holding the account row.

stores.name: sessions:

fields.name: email
fields.note: The Redis key is built as sessions:<user email>, so the address is part of the key.

fields.name: token
fields.note: The session token passed by login is stored as the value.

erasure.note: purge_session deletes the key, but delete_account does not call it and nothing else in the repository does; the 86400-second TTL expires the key independently of the deletion path.

stores.note: Redis keyspace written by store_session at login.

stores.name: stripe

fields.name: name
fields.note: The user's full_name is sent as the Stripe customer name.

erasure.note: The repository creates the Stripe customer and contains no call that deletes or redacts it.

stores.note: Stripe customer created from the signup route.

stores.name: mixpanel

fields.name: email
fields.note: The user's email address is passed as the Mixpanel distinct id.

fields.name: account_created
fields.note: Event name recorded against the user.

erasure.note: The repository sends the event and contains no Mixpanel deletion call.

stores.note: Product analytics service called from the signup route.

stores.name: sendgrid

fields.name: full_name
fields.note: The name is interpolated into the message body sent to the provider.

fields.name: email
fields.note: Recipient address of the welcome message.

erasure.note: The repository sends the message and contains no call that removes it or the recipient from SendGrid.

stores.note: Transactional mail provider called from the signup route.

stores.name: sentry

fields.name: query_string
fields.note: Listed in the repository's own SENTRY_DEFAULT_FIELDS as sent by default.

fields.name: request_body
fields.note: A request body sent to an error tracker can carry whatever the person submitted.

fields.name: local_variables
fields.note: Stack-frame locals captured with an exception can carry any value in scope.

erasure.note: Sentry is initialised at import time and the repository contains no call that deletes events from it.

stores.note: Error tracker initialised when app.py is imported.

retention.criteria: Session keys are written with a 86400-second expiry.
